summary: 15-year-old boy hiking near Lake Dunraven (11,600 ft, ~11 miles from North Fork trailhead) fell ill with chest pain and nausea; pre-existing asthma; trail crew hiked in and Flight for Life flew him from Upper Beaver Meadows to Medical Center of the Rockies
notes: NPS morning report (reported 2010-07-27): park trail crew reached him at 1:35 p.m. July 23
